title: allears.transcribe/v1 result envelope
description: transcribe's batch --json result envelope (issue #63). Success: the one JSON document on stdout. Failure: the last line of stderr; stdout stays byte-empty. Additive keys may appear in later revisions, so consumers must ignore unknown keys (additionalProperties stays permissive on purpose).

output.description: Absolute path of the primary artifact: the .transcript.md.

outputs.description: Absolute paths of every written artifact, primary first (the .transcript.md and its .transcript.json sidecar).

exit_class.description: The exit-code taxonomy label (issue #61); 'unclassified' for any code outside it.
